system.description: You need no longer consign yourself to immobility in the shadows to remain concealed. You may move about as long as you do nothing to attract the attention of others. You may use the crossed-arms pose so long as you avoid interacting with your environment — looking and walking are fine, but talking, dropping something, touching another person or attacking someone ends your concealment. You may use most Disciplines, but certain ones (such as Presence) automatically end your camouflage. You cannot activate this power while someone is observing you.
system.duration: Until an overt action breaks it
